📌 pi-lens active — automated checks run on every edit/write; blocking errors (including pre-existing) show inline and must be fixed.
Key tools (see each tool's own description for args):
• lens_diagnostics — session-wide diagnostic state; mode=all resurfaces stale blocking errors that dropped from turn context.
• symbol_search → module_report → read_symbol/read_enclosing — ranked identifier search, then navigable outline/callback handles + exact body reads; cheaper than reading a whole file before editing.
• lsp_diagnostics — probe LSP for errors in a file/folder/workspace.
• Situational (activate via pi_lens_activate_tools): lsp_navigation, ast_grep_search, ast_grep_replace, ast_grep_dump.
